title: Beyond: Two Souls
provenance: Reported by w8079 (highball-db#367, 2026-10-07), Apple M4, macOS 27.0.1, Highball 0.10.10, engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r21, DXMT set as the game's own mode, rated 4 of 5 after about 4 minutes. The menu and the 3D scene render; frame rate not measured. Not verified by the maintainer.
notes: Renders on DXMT. Start it from Highball's library: a game started from Steam's own window gets the environment's mode, not the one set on its page, and this game shows a black screen on DXVK.

knownIssues.symptom: Black screen with no error box
knownIssues.cause: on DXVK the device is lost (VK_ERROR_DEVICE_LOST, Metal 'Internal Error (0000010d)'); the VK_ERROR_OUT_OF_DEVICE_MEMORY in the same log is misleading, 345 MB of 12 GB were in use (highball-db#367)
knownIssues.fix: set Mode for this game to DXMT on its page and start it from Highball's library, not from Steam's window
